title: French Smoky Macaroni Bake
description: A French-inspired macaroni bake with a smoky twist, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the smoky cheese and stir until melted.
Stir in the cooked macaroni, italian seasonings, bake, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Pour the egg mixture over the macaroni mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the cheese to set.
